name: Kashu Jonin

entries.name: Adept Elementalist
entries.text: You gain resistance to psychic damage and increase all psychic damage you deal by +1 die.

entries.name: Auditory Ninja Tool
entries.text: You gain an Auditory Ninja Tool, a weapon with the Light and Finesse qualities with which you are proficient. This weapon deals either 1d4 bludgeoning damage or Xd4 psychic damage, where X = your level / 4. Attacks that deal psychic damage use your Genjutsu modifier for damage instead of Strength or Dexterity. You may use this tool as a component of any Genjutsu you cast with the Auditory keyword, replacing the Hand Sign (HS) component (if any) and increasing the first instance of damage dealt by +1 damage die.

entries.name: Disorienting Genjutsu
entries.text: Auditory Genjutsu you cast impose a rank of disorientation on a failed save.

entries.name: Fortuitous
entries.text: When subjected to a Constitution saving throw, if you would pass, you instead take no damage and suffer no effects.

entries.name: Stance Break
entries.text: You can use your reaction to initiate a Clash with a creature's jutsu by casting a jutsu you know with a casting time of 1 action. Additionally, the triggering creature rolls at disadvantage.

entries.name: Maximum Volume
entries.text: Genjutsu with the Auditory keyword have their range or area of effect doubled.

entries.name: Elite Controller
entries.text: This adversary gains a +2 bonus to all jutsu save DCs.

entries.name: Controller Passive 1
entries.text: Jutsu you cast that would inflict a condition of any type cannot have their saving throws (if any) made with a jutsu-based bonus that lets the target roll an additional die other than a d20 (such as Bless).

entries.name: Controller Passive 2
entries.text: Once per turn, jutsu you cast that would inflict a penalty of any type also always inflict 1 rank of Concussed.

entries.name: Controller Action
entries.text: By spending 3 Tenacity dice and its action, this adversary can create a chakra surge. When it does, all hostile creatures within 30 feet of this adversary must make a Constitution or Wisdom saving throw (your choice) against your highest save DC. On a failure, they lose the ability to cast jutsu with their actions or bonus actions until the end of your next turn. Once you use this ability, you must spend 5 Tenacity dice to recharge it.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.text: The Kashu Jonin may make three attacks with its currently equipped weapon.

entries.name: Auditory Ninja Tool
entries.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +10 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) bludgeoning damage or 17 (3d4 + 4) psychic damage.

entries.name: Shuriken
entries.text: Ranged Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, range 30/120 ft., one target. Hit: 8 (2d4 + 3) slashing damage.

The Kashu Jonin takes one Elite Action at the end of another creature's turn, once each round, to either move, attack, cast a jutsu, or spend its Elite Action to gain an additional reaction. It regains spent Elite Actions at the beginning of each of its turns.

notes: The Ninjutsu E-Rank cost is printed blank "(Cost: )"; filled in as 2. Disorienting Genjutsu is printed "Disorientating Genjutsu".
